title: According to hall
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：according to　|　正文 358 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 according to 的含义与所引出的成分，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1979 the athlete kept the bib ① according to the old calendar at the track, and everybody in the stadium said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning: the bib had been left ② according to the map in the hall, and nobody had asked a single question. The athlete had come to the stadium two years earlier and spoke little of the stadium he had left behind him.

The programme for September 1973 puts it plainer. It was done ③ according to the rule of the house, and the trainer who kept the bib had counted it ④ according to the oldest man there twice before the winter came; nothing in the stadium was ever done according to the rule of the house in those days. The trainer wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every year thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the bib at the far track, meant something else. He said the whole business had begun ⑤ according to the report of the doctor, and that nobody in his family had ever done it ⑥ according to the needs of the family; he was not a man who explained himself, and the stadium had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1986 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the programme. What the line asked for was that the bib be counted ⑦ according to the plan drawn in spring, and that the names be written ⑧ according to the almanac. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried according to the plan drawn in spring.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1989 she kept the bib  according to the old calendar again when nobody else would, and  according to the map in the hall, she said in 1991, that was the part nobody forgot. She kept the bib in the same track for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the stadium never forgot what had been done according to the map in the hall.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. prep. 根据（表时间：according to the old calendar）
B. prep. 根据（表处所：according to the map in the hall）
C. prep. 按照（表方式／状态：according to the rule of the house）
D. prep. 按照（引出施动者或相关的人：be counted according to the oldest man there）
E. prep. 根据（表原因：according to the report of the doctor）
F. prep. 按照（表对象／目的：according to the needs of the family）
G. prep. 根据（表工具／材料：according to the plan drawn in spring）
H. prep. 按照（表载体／处所：written according to the almanac）

items.q: according to the map in the hall
according to the rule of the house
according to the oldest man there
according to the report of the doctor
according to the needs of the family
according to the plan drawn in spring

answers.why: according to 意为“根据”，此处引出时间 the old calendar（旧历），说明那件小小的号码布是在何时留下的。
according to 意为“根据”，此处引出处所 the map in the hall（厅里那张地图），说明东西被放在何处。
according to 意为“按照”，此处引出方式或状态 the rule of the house（家里的规矩），说明这件事是怎么做成的。
according to 意为“按照”，此处引出施动者或相关的人 那里最年长的人：be counted according to the oldest man there。
according to 意为“根据”，此处引出原因 the report of the doctor（大夫的诊断），说明整件事由何而起。
according to 意为“按照”，此处引出对象或目的 the needs of the family（家里的需要）。
according to 意为“根据”，此处引出工具或材料 the plan drawn in spring（春天画的图样）。
according to 意为“按照”，此处引出载体 the almanac（那本历书）：names written according to the almanac。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1979 年旧历前后，运动员把那件小小的号码布留在了跑道。（according to the old calendar）
那件小小的号码布被放在厅里那张地图，谁也没有过问。（according to the map in the hall）
整件事是家里的规矩做成的，秩序册上写得明白。（according to the rule of the house）
入冬之前，那件小小的号码布已经由那里最年长的人数过两回。（be counted according to the oldest man there）
叔叔说，整件事是由大夫的诊断起的。（according to the report of the doctor）
他说，家里从来没有人为家里的需要做过这件事。（according to the needs of the family）
answers: In 1979 the athlete kept the bib according to the old calendar at the track.
The bib had been left according to the map in the hall, and nobody asked a single question.
It was done according to the rule of the house, or so the programme says.
The bib had been counted according to the oldest man there twice before the winter came.
He said the whole business had begun according to the report of the doctor.
He said nobody in his family had ever done it according to the needs of the family.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 according to 的 4 种不同用法（时间、处所、方式、原因、对象等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1979 the athlete kept the bib according to the old calendar, and nobody forgot it.
The bib had been left according to the map in the hall for three years.
The work was done according to the rule of the house, as it always was in those days.
The bib had been counted according to the oldest man there twice before the winter came.
My mother kept the bib according to the old calendar again when nobody else would.
The whole stadium never forgot what had been done according to the map in the hall.
